REFERRAL LETTER
Date: 10/01/2026
Patient Name: Mara Jennings
DOB: 02/16/1973
MRN: MRN-10625

To: Cardiology Clinic Intake
From: Dr. Felix Moore, Summit Internal Medicine

Dear Colleague,

Reason for referral: Evaluation of breathlessness on exertion.

Mara Jennings is a 53-year-old woman with hypertension, type 2 diabetes mellitus, and hypothyroidism. Over the past six months, she has had gradually worsening breathlessness when climbing stairs or walking uphill. She now pauses after one flight of stairs, with relief after several minutes of rest. She denies fainting, cough, or recent respiratory illness.

I am sending her to your cardiology clinic for evaluation of breathlessness on exertion. Please assess her symptoms and advise on further care.

Dr. Felix Moore
Summit Internal Medicine

Thank you for seeing this patient.

Dr. Felix Moore
Summit Internal Medicine
